fields.description: Refuse a Sales Return raised outside the window below. Off, and nothing changes.
fields.label: Restrict Creating Sales Returns

fields.description: How many days a return may still be raised within. 0 allows the same day only.
fields.label: Days Allowed for a Return

fields.description: Counted from the invoice being returned (the usual retail rule), or from today back to the return's own posting date.
fields.label: Count the Days From
fields.options:
Original Invoice Date
Return Posting Date

fields.description: Roles or users who may raise a return past the window anyway. Administrator always may.
fields.label: Allowed to Override

fields.description: Send Sales Invoice returns through the PM Workflow for Sales Invoice instead of letting them be submitted directly. While this is on, that workflow governs returns only — ordinary invoices keep their own Submit button.
fields.label: Sales Return Approval Enabled

fields.description: Only returns above the threshold need approval. Off, and every return does.
fields.label: Restrict by Return Amount

fields.description: In company currency. A return of this amount or less is submitted directly; above it, approval is required.
fields.label: Approval Threshold

fields.description: Refuse a return that needs approval when no active PM Workflow covers Sales Invoice, instead of letting it through unapproved. Untick only while a workflow is being set up.
fields.label: PM Workflow Approval Mandatory Above the Threshold

fields.description: The four open item reports ignore documents posted before this date. Everything earlier belongs to the system this site was migrated from and was settled there, so a receipt or an invoice left looking open by the import is not a real open item. Leave it empty and every document ever raised is considered.
fields.label: Consider Open Items From

fields.description: Roles or users who may make a Customer available for Sales Invoice without going through the normal Pending Verification -> Approved step. Administrator always may. Every use is logged as a comment on the Customer.
fields.label: Allowed to Bypass Approval

fields.description: Start reminding this many days before a supporting document's expiry date.
fields.label: Remind Before Expiry (days)

fields.description: Keep reminding for this many days after a supporting document has expired, then stop.
fields.label: Keep Reminding After Expiry (days)

fields.description: One row per Company, the same shape as the Item master's own Company-wise account defaults. Location is mandatory on core Asset and nothing maps a Warehouse to one, so a tracking Asset (sf_trading.asset_tracking_item, for an Item with Track as Asset ticked) uses that Company's row here when the purchase row's own Asset Location resolves none. A Company with no row here, or a row with a field left blank, simply leaves that value unresolved for that Company — logged, not guessed, for staff to raise and finish by hand.
fields.label: Asset Tracking Defaults (per Company)
